chinese: 你好，我是马利，我住在泰国！
english: Hi, I’m Malee and I live in Thailand!

chinese: 大象是我最喜欢的动物。
english: The elephant is my favourite animal.

chinese: 我喜欢大象，因为它们强壮又聪明。
english: I love elephants because they are strong and clever.

chinese: 在这里，它们也是好运的象征。
english: They are also a symbol of good luck here.

chinese: 大象是我们的国宝动物。
english: The elephant is our national animal.

chinese: 在3月13日，我们会庆祝泰国大象日。
english: On 13 March, we celebrate Thai Elephant Day.

chinese: 大象看起来与其他动物非常不同。
english: Elephants look very different from other animals.

chinese: 它们非常庞大。
english: They are huge.

chinese: 它们有大耳朵和长鼻子。
english: They have large ears and long trunks.

chinese: 它们可以用鼻子拾起和搬运重物。
english: They can pick up and carry heavy things with their trunks.

chinese: 大象在某些方面和我们很像。
english: Elephants are like us in some ways.

chinese: 它们非常爱玩，喜欢在水里玩耍。
english: They are very playful and love to play in the water.

chinese: 它们是出色的游泳健将。
english: They are great swimmers.

chinese: 它们也很聪明。
english: They are also clever.

chinese: 例如，许多年后它们仍能记住彼此以及有食物和水的地方。
english: For example, they can remember one another and places with food and water after many years.

chinese: 大象也非常善良。
english: Elephants are very kind too.

chinese: 当其他大象感觉不舒服时，它们会照顾彼此。
english: They look after other elephants when they don’t feel well.

chinese: 大的大象也会帮助小的。
english: The big elephants also help the baby ones.

chinese: 大象是泰国生活和文化的重要组成部分。
english: Elephants are an important part of Thai life and culture.

chinese: 然而，它们正处于危险之中。
english: However, they are in danger.

chinese: 它们生活在森林里，但人们砍伐了太多的树木。
english: They live in forests, but people cut down too many trees.

chinese: 人们也为了象牙而猎杀大象。
english: People also kill elephants for their ivory.

chinese: 让我们拯救森林，不要购买象牙制品。
english: Let’s save the forests and not buy things made of ivory.

chinese: 每头大象都很重要。
english: Every elephant counts.
